description:
[Taxonomy C.14 — delegates to scan_bill_for_errors] Detect internal contradictions in a claim: time mismatches, mutually exclusive codes, missing required fields, patient-gender/procedure mismatches.

WHEN TO USE: Caller is building or validating a claim payload before submission — format, structure, completeness, alignment.

WHEN NOT: For an already-submitted and denied claim, use generate_appeal_letter. For market pricing context, use benchmark_payer_rate.
name: claim_consistency_checker
